headline: Waive debts for use of music by Santiago companies
summary: Companies affiliated with the ACIS business association in Santiago will have eight months to formalize music-use licenses. They will not have to pay retroactive amounts for earlier years.
why: Collective management societies collect royalties for public use of music by businesses. Settlements like this affect how much licensing revenue they can recover.
original_headline: Condonan deudas por uso de música a empresas de Santiago
